newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil state rejects protest of telecom share sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil state rejects protest of telecom share sale.

text.p: The Brazilian state of Rio Grande do Sul has rejected a protest over the sale of a 35 percent stake in a state-owned telecommunications company officials said on Tuesday.

A spokeswoman for the state said the complaint was lodged by Italy's Stet SpA, the operating partner of the group that lost in bidding for a stake in Cia Riograndense de Telecomunicacoes. Stet complained that the group that won the tender on Tuesday had not submitted all necessary documentation, she said.
Brazil's Camargo Correa led the losing group.
"The special auction committee rejected the protest," the spokeswoman said.
An hour later, the winning consortium, led by Brazil's RBS Participacoes and including Telefonica de Espana, signed a contract finalizing its purchase.

The group won bidding on the voting shares of Cia Riograndense de Telecomunicacoes with an offer of 681 million reais ($655 million), some 54.8 percent more than the base price set by the state. The consortium has 72 hours to make good on its offer.
